children: ACNB announced rebranding of Traditions Bank and Traditions Mortgage, effective in the first quarter of 2027.
ACNB Bank will rename Traditions Bank locations in York County to ACNB Bank to align branding.
Traditions Mortgage will become ACNB Mortgage across all markets, consolidating mortgage branding.
Rebranding effective Q1 2027; legal entity and ownership, accounts and account numbers remain unchanged.
Transition reflects brand alignment after 2025 acquisition of Traditions Bancorp, not operational change.
